description: Progressive Damage and Failure of Wood-Frame Coastal Residential Structures Due to Hurricane Surge and Wave Forces is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Daniel Cox, Oregon State University (oregonstate.edu). A physical model study was performed to examine the response of two 1:6 scale wood-frame coastal residential structures subjected to storm surge and waves. An on-grade and an elevated specimen were tested. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Elevated wood-frame structure, Hurricane wave, Hydrodynamic test, Overland Storm surge, Progressive damage, Structural tests (free vibration. Published 2021-09-30. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
